mapper.select: EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON SELECT d.id, d.active_file_id, d.active_generation FROM knowledge_document d JOIN file_object f ON f.enterprise_id = d.enterprise_id AND f.id = d.active_file_id WHERE d.enterprise_id = #{sample.enterprise} AND d.resource_id = #{sample.resource} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.active_generation > 0 AND f.status = 'ready' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL

EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON SELECT c.id AS chunk_id, c.document_id, d.resource_id, f.original_name AS name, c.file_id, c.generation, c.locator_json, c.content_text FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.enterprise_id = c.enterprise_id AND d.id = c.document_id AND c.generation <= d.active_generation AND d.active_generation = c.generation AND d.active_file_id = c.file_id JOIN file_object f ON f.enterprise_id = c.enterprise_id AND f.id = c.file_id WHERE c.enterprise_id = #{sample.enterprise} AND d.resource_id = #{sample.resource} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.status = 'ready' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.id IN #{id}
